scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Tribe Women
other_conditions: Only one person per family can receive the benefit
Preference given to ST widows or abandoned women
Beneficiary must purchase the goat unit within 90 days of pre‑approval
Beneficiary must contribute 50 % of the unit cost for food, water, fodder, residence and concentrate expenses
Must maintain records of milk production and provide the register during technical officer visits
Benefit is available only once in a lifetime
If the beneficiary is found disabled, the approval will be cancelled
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy on unit cost up to ₹45,000, available once in a lifetime
documents_required: Printout of the confirmed online application with signature/thumb impression
